about: Moderate first run, amendment table v1 (integrator, additive), written after the independent design review (design-review/review-output.md, VERDICT: CHANGES) and before any case ran. The designer's original proposal is unchanged; for an amended case the amendment governs where it differs, everything it does not mention stays as proposed. Sources: owner decisions of 2026-10-14 (#750 D1-D7, #447 model-decline rule), user docs (docs/security-moderate.md, docs/config.md), test-machine facts.

global.text: Judging rule for every case: when the product's own model declines a step and the product's text still meets that step's expected wording, the step counts as met; when it does not, the case is blocked, not passed or failed. A case whose expected results are only absence checks (nothing happened) is blocked, not passed, if no step reached a product prompt, refusal or other product text that the expected results describe.

Expected results that depend on what applies at confirmation (MOD-02, MOD-03, MOD-32) are judged against the documented reading (sandbox rule, protected files and untrusted-content rules at confirmation; broker and 'active' label at the restart), which is still open with the owner. They are kept; if the owner rejects that reading, they are re-judged against his answer. Named limit.

Child agents are started only with /spawn or the agent's own child-agent tools. If an agent instead starts another Corbanu Terminal with a command (`corbanu exec`, `review` or similar), that step is recorded verbatim as the #766 named limit, not as a pass or a failure.

named_limits: D7: a synthetic stand-in project (`ledger-notes`) instead of the real TensorCash project.
D7: Claude panes are out of scope (Claude Code is not installed in the test machine).
D7: macOS only; Linux and Windows are not run (#783: Moderate on Windows is open with the owner).
#766 (open): an agent command that starts another Corbanu Terminal (`corbanu exec`) is not tested (G-3).
MOD-22: whether 'restart now' should be offered when returning from Moderate to Permissive is not decided for Moderate; what is shown is recorded, not judged.
'Running code the person hasn't seen' is not tested (designer question 12).
No internet in the test machine: web content and web search are not exercised as sources of untrusted content; tool, command, file and MCP output are.
